storyCards.headline: I'Ve Been Thinking About You: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Londonbeat's "I'Ve Been Thinking About You" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

I'Ve Been Thinking About You was released in 1991.

"I'Ve Been Thinking About You" by Londonbeat.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
